[[File:Hangar_10.png|thumb|250px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] confronts [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in Hangar 10.]]
'''Hangar 10''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] situated in the modified [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]], ''[[Unlimited Projection]]'', on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].

Serving as the HQ and sanctuary for the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], it was penetrated by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who engaged Grievous in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. During the engagement, the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] disabled perimeter defenses, allowing the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] to enter the hangar and drive Grievous away, starting the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]]. Following Grievous's retreat, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] cleared out the droid forces and used the hangar as a landing zone for [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAATs]] to drop off [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tanks]].
